data.one_liner: Test utilities for interacting with the flutter_quill editor in widget tests.
data.what_it_does: Provides WidgetTester extensions to simplify testing flutter_quill editors. Allows entering, replacing, and removing text, as well as moving cursors and updating selections.
use_when: You are writing widget tests for a Flutter app using flutter_quill
You need to programmatically interact with a QuillEditor in test cases
avoid_when: You are not using flutter_quill in your project
strengths: Simplifies widget testing for complex rich text editors
Extends standard WidgetTester with intuitive methods
weaknesses: Tightly coupled to a single package (flutter_quill)
data.setup_notes: Add flutter_test and flutter_quill_test as dev dependencies.
